name_input: JKT ENTERPRISES PRIVATE LIMITED; J K T ENTERPRISES PVT LTD
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (slug jkt-enterprises-private-limited) shows 434 shipment records, 17 trading partners, 34 port lanes, latest cargo 2026-02-25. Exact export line: "2026-02-12 | JKT ENTERPRISES PRIVATE LIMITED | TO ORDER | INDIAN IR 64 PARBOILED RICE (NON BASMATI) PACKING: 50 KGS NET IN BOPP BAGS BRANDNAME: CHEVAL FORT | VIZAG SEA INVTZ1, India | Lome, Burkina Faso | HS 10063019 | BOL 9602608". Second export line: "2026-02-13 | JKT ENTERPRISES PRIVATE LIMITED | TO ORDER OF | HULLED SESAME SEEDS PACKED IN 25 KGS NETT IN BROWN PAPER BAG WITH PP LAMINATION | PIPAVAV VICTOR PORT GUJARAT SEA INPAV1, India | Semarang, Indonesia | HS 12074090 | BOL 9651520". Source counter: page header states "Total Shipments 434 Records detected"; rows actually visible on the free page = 4 shipment rows (2 export, 2 import), so 4 of 434 rows seen. Declared HS 100630 is corroborated by the actual export HS 10063019 (parboiled non-basmati rice) — no HS correction needed.
domestic_evidence: No public GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic/export split could be retrieved: thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403, eximpedia.app returned HTTP 403, volza.com returned HTTP 403, and web_search was unavailable (searx connection refused) during this run. Domestic supply therefore not verified either way — null, not invented.
note: Real export shipments are confirmed by dated customs/B-L records, not by website claims: parboiled IR-64 non-basmati rice to Lome, Burkina Faso (BOL 9602608, 2026-02-12, HS 10063019) and hulled sesame to Semarang, Indonesia (BOL 9651520, 2026-02-13, HS 12074090). The company also imports raw pulses (sesame from Sudan, black matpe from Brazil, desi chick peas from Australia), i.e. it is an agro-commodity processor/trader rather than a pure trader. Role: manufacturer_trader (processing + trading of pulses/rice/sesame) — traders are not rejected per project rules. Declared HS 100630 matches the observed rice export code, so no HS correction is required. Caveat on evidence depth: only 4 of the 434 records were visible on the free view, and the 'jkt-enterprises-pvt-ltd' slug variant returned an empty record set, so the 434 figure is the source's own counter, not a count I verified row by row. Domestic (intra-India) supply remains unverified — no GST turnover band or public procurement record was publicly accessible; revenue and domestic turnover: null. No rejection grounds: the entity appears live and actively trading in 2026.
